title: Enterprise Deployments: Readiness & Communications Channel Plan for RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS
creator: Aisha M. Khan
description: Goal: Coordinate a cross-functional communications and enablement plan for the Private/VPC on-prem feature set (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS integrations) so enterprise customers and internal stakeholders have clear release notes, runbooks, and training assets at GA. This ticket captures the orchestration of release notes, legal & compliance signoffs, internal product/SE enablement, public comms cadence, and gating criteria for launch.
acceptance_criteria: Drafted and reviewed release notes covering RBAC roles, audit log schemas, KMS key lifecycle and known limitations
Legal and Security review completed and artifacts versioned (SOC2/ISO references included)
Console and API changelog entries live in docs repo and linked from release notes
Enablement sessions scheduled for Solutions Engineering and Support with slide deck and hands-on lab
Customer-facing onboarding checklist published (including common RBAC templates and KMS key rotation guidance)
Rollout playbook vetted with SRE and Dedicated/Private ops, including rollback criteria
tasks: Coordinate engineering PRs for API change notes and add example payloads (owner: Eng Docs)
Assemble legal compliance blurb and encryption responsibilities (owner: Legal)
Create 45-minute SE enablement deck + 60-minute hands-on lab (owner: DevRel)
Prepare initial release notes draft and internal TL;DR for leadership (owner: PM)
Publish audit log schema examples and retention guidance in docs site (owner: Security/Docs)
Identify 3 pilot customers for early validation and schedule migration Q&A (owner: Customer Success)
Produce console screenshots for RBAC flows and KMS key mapping (owner: Design)
Confirm Dedicated and Private packaging steps for on-prem installers and KMS integrations (owner: Infra Eng)
Finalize rollback and outage runbook with SRE and Support (owner: Reliability)
Coordinate localization scope for release notes if required for EU/JP regions (owner: PM)
Create a short script and copy for email + in-app banner announcing availability to eligible accounts (owner: Growth)
Sync on pricing/contract language for reserved capacity offering if KMS/Private incurs additional costs (owner: RevOps)
Tag all artifacts (docs, decks, PRs) with release:private-2025.03
rollout_steps: GA release gated on Security signoff and two pilot customer validations
Pre-GA: internal beta for SEs and Support for 2 weeks
GA day: publish docs + release notes; send targeted emails to customers with dedicated plan options
Week 1 post-GA: run office hours for adoption and triage feedback
Week 4: collect metrics (adoption, errors, support volume) and decision on expanded availability
communication_templates: Internal TL;DR subject: [Private-2025.03] RBAC + Audit + KMS — GA readiness & key links: <one-liner>
Customer email subject (targeted): Introducing Private Deployments: RBAC controls, audit logs, and KMS support
In-app banner copy: Private Deployments now available for eligible accounts — open the console to configure RBAC and KMS
Release notes header: Overview, Breaking changes, Migration guidance, Known limitations, Links to docs & support
FAQ starter items: How RBAC maps to existing API keys? How are audit logs exported? What KMS providers do we support?
risk_mitigation: Risk: confusion about RBAC vs API key roles — Mitigation: include clear matrix and 3 example role templates
Risk: KMS integration complexity for on-prem — Mitigation: provide a minimal reproducible installer and a reference connector
Risk: audit log volume and retention costs — Mitigation: document recommended retention defaults and S3 export sample
Risk: legal/regulatory blockers in EU customers — Mitigation: early legal review and region-specific notes in release docs
